svg.title: engine step shapes
svg.text: One engine.step: every scheduled request's pieces become ONE flat batch
schedule() → per-request token_ids / positions / slot_mapping → concatenated → one forward pass
flat tensors fed to the model: [T], T = sum of all query lengths
one per request: the index of its LAST token
picks requests and how many tokens each
